# CopilotForge for Microsoft Copilot Cowork

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-cowork.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

One plugin archive per active department, version 0.2.0. Upload the ones you need in Copilot Cowork:
**Customize** > **Plugins** > **Upload plugin**. Cowork converts each archive into a Cowork plugin, including its skills.

Every plugin name starts with `copilotforge-`, so CopilotForge can be installed alongside other skill libraries
without name clashes. The full guide is [docs/COPILOT-COWORK.md](../docs/COPILOT-COWORK.md); suggested custom
instructions are in [custom-instructions.md](custom-instructions.md).
